Game In A Box

What do the grades mean?

Value tier is about price:

  • Common — bulk-bin, easy to find. Roughly under $10-15 USD.
  • Mid — recognisable, still affordable. Roughly $15-40 USD.
  • Uncommon/Rare — real collector demand. Roughly $40+ USD. Big box or solo sale, not the standard box.
  • Grail-exclude — genuine collector grails. Reference only, never stocked.

Filler Trash is a separate flag, not about price — whether the game has any appeal regardless of what it's worth. Only ever applies within Common tier:

  • Repeated annual sports franchises (FIFA, Madden, NBA 2K, NHL, WWE, Tiger Woods, by year)
  • Peripheral-locked party/rhythm games (SingStar, Buzz!, Just Dance, Kinect Sports/Adventures, Dance Central)
  • Generic movie tie-ins (Shrek, Ice Age, Madagascar, Toy Story 3, Finding Nemo, Harry Potter)
  • Budget fitness titles (Zumba Fitness, EA Sports Active, Deca Sports, Carnival Games)

A few genuinely good games get a hand-picked exception despite superficially matching a pattern (e.g. Battle for Bikini Bottom).
